title: Jake Barber's contractor employers, Northrop per Danny Sheehan

tellings.quote: And I think Danny Sheen accused him of being at Northrup.

plain: Michels says that the lawyer Danny Sheehan accused a man named Jake Barber, who has spoken about working for defense contractors, of having been at the defense company Northrop. Michels tells this himself, hedging with "I think", in a conversation about how the Pentagon's UFO programs work. It matters because it bears on who Barber actually worked for.
